title: General RSS and Atom monitor source type
description: hn-rss is hard-coded to Hacker News. Add a source type whose feeds are configuration, with allowed hosts, starting with arXiv: skip announce_type replace and replace-cross, keep new and cross, one source id per paper, abstract carried as the item's text so a decision does not fetch the PDF.
